corrections.reason: The printed glyph has the 5th-order (ኃምስ) loop on the right leg (ቴ in አቴና, reed/flax mat), not 3rd-order ቲ.

Both visually in the print and philologically in the Ge'ez speech of Rahab ('ነገህ ትወርሱ ሀገረነ ወትቀትሉ ነገሥታቲነ' — 'Tomorrow you shall inherit our land and slay our kings'), the first word on the line is ነገህ, misread as ገብታ.
